changes.summary: Serialize concurrent permission upserts by name and preserve the original admin-role lookup or permission seeding error instead of continuing an aborted transaction.
Recognize custom context error identity through errors.Is when no explicit classification or context sentinel was found during ordered traversal.
Fix the Revenue Trend dashboard panel's date field and document the CSS build step before starting the development server.
Allow HTMX test interactions to finish after superseded XHR cancellation while still rejecting newer send failures and waiting for the winning swap to settle.
Test-only six-pixel rounded-menu rasterization allowance; no runtime change.
Preserve exact two-decimal transaction amounts in Payme checkout links instead of adding a tiyin through floating-point ceiling.
Preserve context cancellation at database boundaries, reject mismatched localization IDs, and prevent GraphQL protocol extensions from overriding execution error safety.
Add a database-boundary wrapper that preserves private diagnostic context while classifying driver errors safely.
Add an opt-in, unstable preview of typed errors and safe boundary projections without changing existing error APIs.
Run service-free SDK pull request checks for stacked branches as well as main and staging targets.
